faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for LIFE Mission Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 1 November 2026. Applications opened on 18 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in LIFE Mission Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies: 4 Civil Engineer, 1 Architect, 1 Electrical Engineer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for LIFE Mission Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 1 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years (as on 1 October 2026).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: ₹40,000 for Civil Engineer, ₹40,000 for Architect, ₹40,000 for Electrical Engineer.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduation in Civil Engineering / Architecture / Electrical Engineering from a recognised University. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants must be citizen of India. Applicants having qualification equivalent to prescribed qualification should submit equivalency certificate.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants with incomplete/incorrect application form. Applicants uploading mark sheets, consolidated mark sheets, or statements instead of certificates.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Application screening. Criteria-based screening. Written test. Group discussion.
